description: Edits a prompt by its promptGroupId. Changing text or intent creates a new version under the same group — history stays attached to the version that produced it. tags and active change in place. Reactivating counts against the plan limit.

intent.description: Why someone asks the prompt. informational = learning about a topic; comparison = weighing named options; commercial = choosing what to buy; navigational = looking for a specific site; problem = fixing something. Decides which diagnostic rules apply.

name: shruwd_update_prompt
title: Update prompt
